{{Quote|I knew you could get rid of that pest, Master Logray. But how did you do it?''"<br />"''By using a potion I made from blue Olap leaves.|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and Logray|<ref name="Blue Harvest" />}}
'''Olap leaves''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|leaf]] found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Blue Harvest" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the mention of Olap leaves in "[[Blue Harvest]]," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] used [[Color/Legends|blue]] Olap leaves to make a [[Love potion|potion]].<ref name="Blue Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olap leaves were mentioned in "[[Blue Harvest]],"<ref name="Blue Harvest" /> the twelfth episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and [[Sam Wilson]], and it premiered on [[November 23]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
